Who can open the page.
• Public — all visitors.
• Approved participants — event participants only.
• Moderators only — the page is not in the site menu.

The page position in the menu. Applied on publishing.
• First — before standard and extra pages.
• After “Challenges” — before results.
• After “Results” — if results are shown for this event.
• After an extra page — right after it.

Up to 255 characters.
